messages:
zara: noticing an IOPS spike on local NVMe in ap-south2; attach queue length up and p99 read latency shooting from ~10ms to ~800ms on a small cohort. anyone seeing this elsewhere?

ben: yep saw it at ~14:05 UTC. not full device fail but repeated read-retries on several hosts in rack r12. SMART shows rising media_err_count for that cohort.

ops-bot: Alert: nvme-read-retries (ap-south2) count=9 threshold=4. Incident: INC-20260401-APS2-NVME.

mika: quick mitigations: throttle scrub jobs for that cohort to 12 concurrency, flip scratch scheduler to noop on affected nodes, and divert ephemeral GPU provisioning away from ap-south2 for non-critical queues.

zara: applying scrub throttle now: `opsctl storage tune --cohort nvme-ap2-hot --scrub-concurrency 12`

ben: I'll pick one repro host (host-aps2-223) and try a micro firmware bump after hours of monitoring. risk: host reboot.

mika: cost note: diverting adds ~3% extra regional egress and increases build latency for some teams. keep product in the loop if we extend.

ops-bot: Command executed: storage tune (user: zara). Incident updated.

zara: monitoring p99 and attach queue; will report back after the firmware test.
